$comment: The only hand-written file in this store. It exists only where the accepted target states more than one brand, and check:archetype-assets fails while a contradiction is unadjudicated OR while a decision has gone stale. `variants` lists the brand identities the archetype keeps beside its primary one (owner decision, mwg-train-4xg). Delete it the moment the target speaks with one voice.

brand.because: Owner decision (Paul Kinlan, 2026-10-13): 'we probably need both'. The booking archetype keeps both brands rather than resolving to one: 'Evening Class Studio' is the primary brand, the name in this archetype's own heading and on all five reference boards, and 'Learning Hub' is a supported variant of the same archetype - the brand the interactive demo's product pages state in their own titles. A build renders the primary brand unless it is deliberately building the Learning Hub variant, and the demo is not drift to be renamed.
